comments.content: The method `get_doc_ids_by_doc_names` returns `None` when no documents are found, but the caller in `api_app.py` line 617 iterates over the result with `for doc_id in req.get("doc_ids", []):` and `if doc_id not in doc_ids:`. If `doc_ids` is `None`, this will raise a TypeError. Return an empty list `[]` instead of `None` for consistency and safety.

The variable `doc_ids` may be `None` if `get_doc_ids_by_doc_names` returns `None` (when no documents found by name). This will cause a TypeError when checking `if doc_id not in doc_ids`. Ensure `doc_ids` is initialized as an empty list: `doc_ids = DocumentService.get_doc_ids_by_doc_names(...) or []`.
